name: M1 the fail-open returns: no rule falls back to row_count
aimed_at: T3 missing rule, T5 fault distinguishable
old:
base.status = 'unknown';
    base.note = 'no usable current-data rule for this table — freshness was not checked';

name: M2 the shipped {sql,params} shape stops being recognised
aimed_at: T1 shipped rule evaluated, T2 fresh when current

name: M3 the sql rule is asked but its answer is ignored
M4 an unrunnable rule is reported as a pass
aimed_at: T4 unusable rule, T5 fault distinguishable
old:
base.status = 'unknown';
    base.note = `current-data rule could not be evaluated: ${e.message}`;
new:
base.status = 'fresh';
    base.note = `current-data rule could not be evaluated: ${e.message}`;

name: M5 an unrunnable rule is filed as merely stale
old:
base.status = 'unknown';
    base.note = `current-data rule could not be evaluated: ${e.message}`;
new:
base.status = 'stale';
    base.note = `current-data rule could not be evaluated: ${e.message}`;

name: M6 the fault is reported with no reason attached
aimed_at: T3 missing rule note, T4 unusable rule note
old: base.note = 'no usable current-data rule for this table — freshness was not checked';

name: M7 an evaluation failure is rethrown, taking the panel down
aimed_at: T4 unusable rule degrades rather than throws
old:
base.status = 'unknown';
    base.note = `current-data rule could not be evaluated: ${e.message}`;

name: M8 the banner loses its rendering path for unknown
M9 unchecked is folded back into not-current
aimed_at: T7 unchecked is not reported as stale
old:
const behind = report.tables.filter(t => t.status === 'stale' || t.status === 'empty');
  const unchecked = report.tables.filter(t => t.status === 'unknown');
new:
const behind = report.tables.filter(t => t.status !== 'fresh');
  const unchecked = [];

name: C1 control: a comment is rewritten, nothing behavioural
old: const nonEmpty = v => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '';
new: const nonEmpty = (v) => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== ''; // reworded

name: C2 control: an anchor that does not exist
aimed_at: nothing — this row must report NOT APPLIED
